title: Private sector companies with wet works arms

tellings.quote: they all kind of seem to warn about the same thing um particularly from the private sector that there's certain uh private sector companies that they that they you know claim have some nefarious actors that will do kinetic activity.

plain: Some private companies tied to secret UFO work are said to employ people who will use violence, which spies call "wet works" or "kinetic activity", against those who talk. Eric Burlison, a congressman, tells Michels that whistleblowers including David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who testified to Congress about hidden UFO programmes, and another insider named Jake Barber all warned him of the same thing: "certain private sector companies" with "nefarious actors that will do kinetic activity." If true, it would mean people coming forward face physical danger from contractors, not just the government.
